newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers edge higher with crude, supplies.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers edge higher with crude, supplies.

text.p: Singapore bunkers were quoted higher on crude gains and tight supplies, traders said on Monday.

Bunker indications were far apart with majors quoting around $1 higher from Friday's levels. Bunker 180-cst prices were indicated at $131 by majors and $126 by independents. Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $121-$124.

Traders said enquiries were healthy as most shipowners plan to buy ahead of the Christmas holidays next week. A major said supplies were also tight. MDO and gas oil quotes were steady at $230-$250 and $254-$257 respectively.
